title: Uniswap V2 fee switch is LIVE on the mainnet factory (feeTo 0xf385...5f85); quotePool's NatSpec treats fee-on as hypothetical and code-scan MR-004 cleared the sync()/feeTo interaction on the false premise 'feeTo is off'
description: Code-scan MR-004 cleared the feeTo interaction with sync() on the premise 'feeTo is off on the mainnet V2 factory'. That premise is false. `cast call 0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f feeTo()` returns 0xf38521f130fcCF29dB1961597bc5d2B60F995f85 today, and BalancerWinddownPlan.md:174 already records it as live (UNIfication, Dec 2025). Consequences: (a) at the zap's addLiquidity, _mintFee mints feeTo about 1/6 of the sqrt(k) growth since kLast. That growth includes any donation folded in by sync() (and, pre-fix, by swap) and the swap fees. (b) quotePool computes expectedLP from the pre-fee totalSupply. The fee-on branch of its NatSpec is therefore the live case, not a hypothetical. Our minted LP count is ≥ the quote, so minLP is still a valid floor in LP units, but each LP unit carries the feeTo dilution.
impact: None from UniPoolerV2 code. With feeTo live, the factory mints feeTo about 1/6 of sqrt(k) growth since kLast at each mint/burn. That growth includes our swap fees and any donation folded in by sync(), because sync() updates reserves without touching kLast. This dilution is standard Uniswap V2 pair economics, applies to every LP, and is not caused or worsened by the pooler.
assumptions: Mainnet factory feeTo = 0xf385...5f85 (live), per sanitizer verification
severityJustification: The quotePool NatSpec says that if the protocol fee is on, the fee share is minted before ours and 'only raises our LP'. That conditional statement is correct. In V2 mint(), _mintFee raises _totalSupply before our liquidity is computed, so actual LP >= quoted LP and minLP remains a valid floor. The finding still has value because the pipeline premise in code-scan MR-004 ('feeTo is off') is false on mainnet, and any later reasoning about sync()/donation beneficiaries must allow for feeTo's roughly 1/6 cut of k growth. That matters for F-02-051. No code path loses value, no floor becomes unsafe, and no availability changes. This is a QA/NC premise correction. It is kept as Q, not dropped, because a downstream rationale was built on the false premise.
recommendation: Change the NatSpec to state that feeTo is live on the mainnet factory and remove the hypothetical framing. Carry 'feeTo LIVE' forward as a pipeline premise. MR-004's conclusion survives; its reasoning does not.

premiseCorrection.falseClaim: code-scan MR-004: 'feeTo is off on the mainnet V2 factory' (disposition 'cleared').
premiseCorrection.correctedFact: cast call 0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f feeTo() returned 0xf38521f130fcCF29dB1961597bc5d2B60F995f85 at scan time (UNIfication, Dec 2025; BalancerWinddownPlan.md:174 already records it). feeTo is governance-mutable.
premiseCorrection.why: feeTo takes at most 1/6 of sqrt(k) growth since kLast (donation- and fee-driven). LP value never falls below its pre-growth level; minted LP >= quote, so minLP remains a valid unit floor. Fork tests on the real feeTo-on pair assert LP >= quote (faithfulness 051-T).
premiseCorrection.directive: Downstream agents and later runs must carry the corrected premise; do not inherit 'feeTo is off' from MR-004.
